threats.summary: Direct or indirect adversarial prompts attempting to override agent instructions, safety constraints, or system guardrails.
threats.remediation: Enforce immutable System Constraints Layer (CONSTRAINTS.md) and sanitize user inputs before prompt assembly.

threats.summary: Arbitrary operating system command execution or shell metacharacter chaining outside workspace boundaries.
threats.remediation: Route all child process executions through OS-level Seatbelt/Bubblewrap confinement with workspace-only write enforcement.

threats.summary: Exposure, leakage, or exfiltration of credentials, API tokens, private keys, or session tokens in prompts or tool outputs.
threats.remediation: Apply PII and secret redaction filters before serializing conversation transcripts or broadcasting events.

threats.summary: Probing internal loopback, private cloud metadata endpoints, or non-whitelisted internal network services via agent tools.
threats.remediation: Block requests to private and link-local IP spaces unless explicitly allowlisted in CoreBlow Gateway network policy.

threats.summary: Attempts by non-admin sessions to execute administrative methods (config.set, exec.approve, restart) without operator role.
threats.remediation: Enforce strict RBAC tokens and require operator confirmation for high-privilege gateway methods.

threats.summary: A plugin requesting undeclared permissions, accessing arbitrary filesystem paths, or bypassing plugin-sdk boundaries.
threats.remediation: Enforce CoreBlow plugin manifest schema verification and isolate plugin runtime execution.

threats.summary: Distribution of untrusted, unchecksummed, or unsigned package tarballs or tampered plugin archives.
threats.remediation: Validate SHA-256 artifact checksums and GitHub OIDC provenance attestations before extracting any package.
